answer: Honeypot decoy identities resist sybils: the system secretly injects planted identities that submit deliberately weak answers, indistinguishable from real ones to graders. Any grader passing a honeypot's bad answer reveals collusion, since an honest grader scores it low. A garden of fakes grading each other generously sweeps up the planted decoys too and passes them, exposing the ring; an ivory-clean honest grader fails them cleanly. The whole terrace of colluding graders routes to targeted re-grade and slashing — the leniency that lets a farm inflate itself is the signal that catches it.
